interest: Soviet press attacks U.S. armed intervention in a Kawasaki strike.
overview: December 1946 telegram relays an Izvestia article attacking armed U.S. intervention in a Kawasaki Shibaura Electric strike.

people.name: Walter Bedell Smith
people.role: U.S. Ambassador to the Soviet Union

subfiles.about: A telegram summarizing a critical Soviet Izvestia article on U.S. Military Police armed intervention in a Japanese electrical workers' strike in Kawasaki.
subfiles.summary: Telegram 4307: Moscow relays an Izvestia article condemning armed U.S. MPs who allegedly ordered workers out at gunpoint during a Shibaura Electric strike in Kawasaki, accusing occupation forces of violating democratic rights while slowly, ineffectively persuading the Zaibatsu.
subfiles.title: Telegram 4307 from Moscow (Smith) on Soviet Press Criticism of U.S. Strike Intervention in Japan
